evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The opposition of owned vs. rented intelligence appeals to self-origination and control over one's own cognitive resources.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and to personal accumulation of durable value (self-enhancement).
Naming a thesis around individually-owned intelligence carries the autonomy value of self-origination as the appealed-to good.
